securityNotes: Read SKILL.md and every referenced file in full at the pinned SHA. taste/design-taste.md (the anti-slop doctrine: Brief Inference, Banned Defaults checklist, Variance Mandate) and taste/aesthetic-systems.md (6 archetypes + pointer to a 138-system library) are plain reference prose, no hidden instructions. scripts/validate_contrast.py and scripts/validate_theme_refs.py, read in full, are pure local file/regex checkers (json, re, sys, pathlib stdlib only) with no network calls, no credential access, no remote execution; validate_tokens.py and contrast.py were already reviewed for the design-tokens/a11y-audit manifests. Same license resolution as the other picks from this repo: no repo LICENSE file, package.json SPDX "license": "MIT" / "author": "plugin87" used per the brief.

proposedEntry.name: brandkit
proposedEntry.description: Stands up a complete, accessible brand design system from a brief before any screen is built: infers industry/audience/mood/motion-depth and anchors to an aesthetic archetype, generates an 11-shade OKLCH brand color ramp plus a neutral ramp verified for contrast (500 shade >=4.5:1 on white for text, 600 >=3:1 for UI), maps roles to a semantic layer (action, text, surface, border, feedback) with designed (not inverted) dark-mode overrides, defines a Major Third type scale, 4px spacing scale, radius/elevation/motion tiers, and emits three-tier DTCG tokens plus a single shared theme.css. Runs token-validity, contrast, and theme-reference-resolution scripts as its definition of done.
triggers: generate a new color palette and type system
set up light and dark mode from scratch
inputs: A brief: industry, audience, mood, motion depth
outputs: A single theme.css with light and dark overrides
Passing token-validity, contrast, and theme-reference-resolution checks

modifications.description: Upstream SKILL.md references repo-root shared files (taste/design-taste.md, taste/aesthetic-systems.md, .claude/rules/tokens-and-color.md, scripts/validate_tokens.py, scripts/validate_contrast.py, scripts/validate_theme_refs.py) outside the skill's own directory. Bundled the specific referenced files into the vendored skill directory at the same relative paths already used in the prose, so no wording had to change. Did NOT bundle the 138-file design-systems/library archetype catalog referenced indirectly via taste/aesthetic-systems.md's 'Library' section -- that catalog is shared across multiple skills in the upstream repo and is disproportionate to include for this one skill; the skill remains usable via its 6 named archetypes without it.

logMd:
#### plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills -- brandkit (inspected 2026-08-26)

See a11y-audit.json for shared repo-level evidence. brandkit: read SKILL.md plus taste/design-taste.md, taste/aesthetic-systems.md, .claude/rules/tokens-and-color.md, scripts/validate_tokens.py, scripts/validate_contrast.py, scripts/validate_theme_refs.py in full; all clean. Deliberately did not bundle the 138-file design-systems/library/*/DESIGN.md archetype catalog that aesthetic-systems.md points to -- disproportionate for a single skill's manifest; the skill still functions via its 6 named archetypes. Rubric: relevance 3, quality 3 (concrete OKLCH generation with exact ratios, explicit semantic role list, definition-of-done scripts), conformance 1 (fixed via portability modification, catalog knowingly left out), uniqueness 1 (overlaps registry's theme-factory, which applies 10 curated static palette+font themes to documents/slides -- brandkit instead generates a full brief-driven DTCG token system with dark-mode and code-level verification scripts, a different output and depth). Total 8, vendor.
- Curator decision 2026-08-26: NOT vendored after validation - Bundled taste/aesthetic-systems.md links ~140 DESIGN.md files in the upstream design-systems/library plus frameworks/adapter-protocol.md; the skill is not self-contained without that 138-file library, which is disproportionate to vendor. Install from upstream instead.
